summary: With a mock module, fail_json doesn't stop execution, so either make it raise or assert it wasn't called, for example module.fail_json.assert_not_called().
questions: Why doesn't fail_json stop my test when using MagicMock?
How do I check a function didn't fail in a module unit test?

answer_card.title: Make failures visible with mock modules
answer_card.answer_md:
A mock's `fail_json` just returns another mock, so failures go unnoticed. Either make it raise an exception, or assert it wasn't called:
```python
module = MagicMock()
function_to_test(module, argument)
module.fail_json.assert_not_called()
```
Do this for any function that receives the module object.
